//: Fastify HTTP server + in-process simulation engine. Imports @work-sim/shared via the tsconfig path alias (no publish step).
name: @work-sim/api

scripts.//dev: Watch-mode dev server. tsx loads the path-aliased shared package directly from source.
scripts.//build: Type-check + emit. Production startup is `node dist/index.js`.
scripts.//db:push: Apply the Drizzle schema to the local SQLite file. Disposable; delete *.db to reset between schema iterations.

dependencies.// DEPENDENCY @fastify/cors: Allow the Vite dev origin (localhost:5173) to call the API.
dependencies.// DEPENDENCY better-sqlite3: Synchronous SQLite driver — safe for single-process use.
dependencies.// DEPENDENCY openai: Official OpenAI SDK; uses chat.completions.parse for strict structured outputs.
dependencies.// DEPENDENCY zod: Re-imported here for route-handler convenience; the canonical version is in shared.
dependencies.// DEPENDENCY uuid: v4 ids for runs and rounds.
